A28-3-intro.quote: The subject matter, duration, nature and purpose of the processing, the types of personal data and the categories of data subjects are described in Annex 1

A28-3-a.quote: only on documented instructions from the Customer, unless required to do so by Union or Member State law
missingElements: instructions cover transfers to third countries

A28-3-a2.quote: immediately inform the Customer if, in its opinion, an instruction infringes the GDPR

A28-3-c.quote: Northwind shall take all measures required pursuant to Article 32 GDPR

A28-2.quote: The Customer gives Northwind general written authorisation to engage the Sub-processors listed in Annex 3

A28-3-d.quote: Northwind shall respect the conditions set out in this Section 5 and in Article 28(2) and 28(4) GDPR

A28-4.quote: Northwind shall remain fully liable to the Customer for the performance of that Sub-processor's obligations

A28-3-f.quote: assist the Customer in ensuring compliance with its obligations pursuant to Articles 32 to 36 GDPR

P-BREACH-TIME.quote: within a reasonable time after becoming aware of it

P-TRANSFER.quote: the Standard Contractual Clauses adopted by the European Commission

P-RETENTION.quote: Northwind keeps Customer Personal Data in its backups for thirty (30) days after the Agreement ends
P-RETENTION.conflictQuote: Backups of Customer Personal Data are kept for ninety (90) days after the Agreement ends

P-LIABILITY.quote: subject to the limitation of liability in the Agreement

P-AI-TRAIN.quote: shall not use Customer Personal Data, including call recordings and transcripts, to train
P-AI-TRAIN.conflictQuote: improving Northwind's speech recognition models by training them on call recordings

P-DPO.quote: Northwind's data protection officer can be contacted

P-EUREP.note: Northwind is established in Ireland; not applicable.

defects.description: General authorisation for sub-processors, but no notice of changes and no right to object.
No deletion or return clause at the end of services.
No assistance with data subject rights requests.
Instructions clause does not cover transfers to third countries.
mustContain: only on documented instructions from the Customer, unless required

defects.description: Breach notice 'within a reasonable time', no number of hours.
Sub-processor list has no location column.
Security measures incorporated by reference to an Annex 2 that is not provided.
Backup retention is 30 days in Section 8 and 90 days in Annex 1.
mustContain: thirty (30) days after the Agreement ends
ninety (90) days after the Agreement ends
